about: What each instrument is called and what it reports, for any client to show beside it and on asking (the owner, 14 November: an instrument the player cannot read is noise). A short label, and a gloss of one or two light sentences. Read by src/presentation/instruments.ts; a client displays them and interprets nothing.

sky.label: Sky
sky.gloss: The moon's age. To one who reads the stars, the sign rising this month.

provisions.label: Provisions
provisions.gloss: Days of food in the company's packs, and the light it carries. Hunger and the dark come when they run out.
